aggregation: Within each target-level split, observations are collapsed to the observed 6-bit evidence-presence states (≤64 cells). Original target-disease pair counts are retained as weights; continuous per-channel evidence scores enter as within-cell means.
ganglion: Six channel-specific encoders map [evidence score, evidence-present flag] to 16D; the six vectors are averaged; a shared 16×16 tanh ganglion produces the common evidence state; a sigmoid terminal head estimates human-outcome probability.
objective: weighted Bernoulli log loss on human clinical outcome
baseline_models: linear logistic on six scores + six presence flags
polynomial logistic with pairwise score and presence interactions
precision_check: For two strong ganglion initialisations, combine ganglion and polynomial logits with validation-selected alpha in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1}.
